name: Mornye Python
description: Uses a Mornye Python server (web mode, running in Docker) as a track download source. Mornye must be configured with its own extensions; this plugin does not include any.
uses: A download folder shared with the Mornye container

settings.label: Mornye URL
settings.help: Base URL of Mornye web mode, for example http://mornye:8000

settings.label: Mornye web token
settings.help: The MORNYE_WEB_TOKEN value. Leave empty if Mornye has no token.

settings.label: Shared download folder
settings.help: A folder mounted into both Mornye and Aurral. Give its path inside the Mornye container (for example /data/mornye). Use the same container path in Aurral and nothing else is needed.

settings.label: Shared folder path in Aurral (optional)
settings.help: Only if Aurral mounts the folder at a different path than Mornye. Aurral's remote path mappings don't apply to plugins. Leave empty to use the path above.

settings.label: Quality
settings.help: LOSSLESS (default), HI_RES_LOSSLESS, HI_RES, HIGH or LOW

settings.label: Providers
settings.help: Leave empty to use every installed, enabled Mornye provider in its own priority order, with fallback (recommended). Otherwise list extension ids, comma-separated.

settings.label: Download timeout (minutes)
settings.help: Give up on a download after this long. Default 60.
